interpretation: Candidates are work performed by database careers. They do not imply executable capabilities, DBMS vendor qualification, Shell/Workbench implementation, privileges, project approval or complete discovery. Workstream is primary; cross-functional approvals still apply.

scopeLabels.database-scoped: Candidate for native DBMS Driver/Shell/Workbench requirement analysis
scopeLabels.database-adjacent: Database-side evidence or export only; downstream BI/AI/governance/consulting products excluded
scopeLabels.out-of-product: Profession may do this but NuBloxSQL is not a DBMS storage/query engine

activities.title: Select and qualify database technologies
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Publish reproducible vendor/version selection evidence with explicit rejected options and support limits.

activities.title: Define service strategy and operating standards
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Confirm accountable database service owner, operational standards, review history and recorded exceptions.

activities.title: Design logical and physical data architecture
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Review conceptual/logical/physical models with identities, relationships, assumptions and traceable decisions.

activities.title: Engineer schema and database objects
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Apply versioned native object definitions to a disposable target; compare actual schema to approved specification.

activities.title: Develop and execute SQL and programmable routines
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Demonstrate safe parameterised native statements with bounded results, type fidelity, execution and rollback evidence.

activities.title: Inspect host and engine prerequisites
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Inspect an authorised target without mutations; report missing host and DBMS prerequisites.

activities.title: Plan engine installation and configuration
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Review a target-specific install plan with prerequisites, security assumptions, abort conditions and rollback.

activities.title: Install and initialise database engine/runtime
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Install and initialise a disposable engine; verify product identity and functional readiness.

activities.title: Discover managed database instances and schema
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Capture native server/schema metadata from a real instance; show permission errors and unsupported fields honestly.

activities.title: Bootstrap databases and namespaces
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Bootstrap an authorised disposable database or namespace and verify ownership and creation evidence.

activities.title: Manage database configuration and extensions
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Compare native configuration to baseline; verify an authorised change and recovery route.

activities.title: Set security and access policies
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Review least-privilege access policy and segregation of duties; test denied native actions.

activities.title: Administer principals and privileges
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Compare native principals/grants before and after approved access changes, including deny cases.

activities.title: Define backup/recovery and continuity targets
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Record database-specific RPO/RTO and backup/recovery approval with dependencies and verification criteria.

activities.title: Perform backups and verify recoverability
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Create native backup with source/version, integrity evidence and recoverability check.

activities.title: Restore and rehearse disaster recovery
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Restore onto an isolated target and test integrity, access and measured recovery results.

activities.title: Observe sessions, locks and operational health
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Capture dated engine health, sessions and locks, distinguishing observable features from unsupported ones.

activities.title: Optimise database queries and indices
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Compare real explain plans and workload measurements before/after a tuning recommendation.

activities.title: Forecast capacity and availability
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Produce capacity forecast with observed inputs, time horizon, caveats and review threshold.

activities.title: Manage replication and high availability
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Collect native replication topology and verify readiness without pretending an untested failover succeeded.

activities.title: Diagnose incidents and restore service
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Reproduce a controlled outage; record diagnostic timeline, approved action and verified recovery.

activities.title: Monitor security posture and audit evidence
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Collect native security posture and audit evidence with timestamps and secrets removed.

activities.title: Govern data quality, lineage and metadata
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Export native metadata and dependency evidence; identify enterprise governance assertions as external.

activities.title: Engineer data movement and change capture
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Move test data with scoped native credentials, bounded streaming and reconciliation evidence.

activities.title: Plan schema migrations and impact
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Compare two schema snapshots, native dependencies, irreversible steps and approval gates.

activities.title: Execute and verify database changes
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Execute a reviewed database migration on a disposable engine and verify before/after effects.

activities.title: Control database releases and approvals
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Demonstrate release authorisation, recovery decision and traceable versioned change evidence.

activities.title: Plan and assess database upgrades
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Review proposed engine upgrade against versions, extensions, clients, outages and fallback.

activities.title: Execute database engine upgrades
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Perform a disposable, version-qualified engine upgrade and validate data and service readiness.

activities.title: Establish retention, archival and retirement policy
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Record retention, legal-hold and approved database retirement conditions before deletion.

activities.title: Archive, revoke, decommission and verify disposal
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Show archived evidence, revoked access and final decommission proof for a disposable target.

activities.title: Test database change, integrity and performance
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Run real-engine integrity/performance/migration tests with reproducible fixtures and failures.

activities.title: Research DBMS internals and portable semantics
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Document version-specific native protocol compatibility using real samples and negative tests.

activities.title: Develop database runtime drivers and protocols
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Verify driver connect, authentication, data and error fidelity, timeout and cleanup on a real native engine.

activities.title: Publish database documentation and training
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Produce accurate database-focused protocol/API guides and working examples, not a generic training platform.

activities.title: Engineer analytics, models and reporting datasets
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Validate a database-side analytical dataset with repeatable queries; BI/dashboard delivery remains downstream.

activities.title: Engineer AI retrieval and vector data integration
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Qualify native vector/index/retrieval capabilities; external RAG and ML training remain downstream.

activities.title: Assess client database needs and advise solutions
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Publish a database-specific options assessment grounded in native version/security evidence.

activities.title: Engineer specialized graph/time-series/geospatial workloads
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Validate actual graph, geospatial or time-series native workload features without fake SQL translation.

activities.title: Develop DBMS storage/query internals
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Record DBMS-internal research and tests separately from deliverable NuBloxSQL Driver capabilities.

activities.title: Approve database service ownership and service-level goals
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Record target criticality, service owner, recovery thresholds, measurable SLO and approval.

activities.title: Assess managed-cloud DB connectivity and identity risks
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Specify product/region/protocol, TLS, auth/credential expiry, private routing and unknowns.

activities.title: Qualify a real vendor/version and native protocol
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Exercise a known engine version against real protocol including explicit negative cases.

activities.title: Approve engine installation provenance and privileges
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Review fixed installer source, target identity, privilege needs and recoverable stop points.

activities.title: Rehearse installation failure and safe recovery
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Demonstrate prerequisite failure, no unsafe partial state and tested recovery on a disposable host.

activities.title: Authorise initial database security baseline
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Document bootstrap identity, initial permissions, defaults and approval before initialization.

activities.title: Verify engine startup and bootstrap configuration
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Check version, readiness, identity and grants on an isolated freshly initialised engine.

activities.title: Govern discovery scope and sensitive metadata
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Compare allowed/denied native discovery requests and redact sensitive metadata.

activities.title: Compare database inventory versions and drift
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Compare two versioned real inventories and show confirmed changes versus unknown identity.

activities.title: Approve schema interface and compatibility contract
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Trace data types, constraints, consumers, owners and rollback assumptions to design approval.

activities.title: Test repeatable native schema deployment
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Run versioned DDL twice on disposable DBMS, compare schemas and report irreversible steps.

activities.title: Set native query and export controls
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Prove unauthorised queries/exports are denied and result/timeout limits are reviewable.

activities.title: Execute bounded native query/export with reconciliation
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Demonstrate cancellation, parameterisation, bounded output and export reconciliation.

activities.title: Review diagnostics measurement baseline
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Confirm target identity, measurement window and reproducible sample before tuning recommendation.

activities.title: Inspect native dependencies and database impact
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Show actual DBMS dependencies and label unverified lineage links as uncertain.

activities.title: Approve maintenance window and recovery point
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Approve target, window, backup point, operator identity, failure thresholds and restoration plan.

activities.title: Perform engine-qualified maintenance and health check
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Execute on disposable target and verify no unexpected integrity/data loss.

activities.title: Rotate database credentials with session checks
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Prove replacement credentials work, previous credentials fail and logs have no secrets.

activities.title: Review incident root cause and preventive actions
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Link repeat incidents to native evidence, corrective owner and measurable verification date.

activities.title: Approve migration cutover and fallback
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Record source/target identities, tolerances, reconciliations, approval and stop condition.

activities.title: Reconcile migration cutover and test fallback
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Validate counts/checksums/object parity and rollback where native semantics permit.

activities.title: Assess legal hold and retention before retirement
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Refuse destructive retirement unless holds, ownership, retention and final backup reviewed.

activities.title: Verify disposal, access revocation and archival evidence
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Confirm authorised deletion/revocation and preservation of required evidence.

activities.title: Qualify native protocol error and recovery behaviour
activities.acceptanceEvidence: Run real-engine negative tests for timeouts, cancellations, auth failure and reconnect.
